scope_change.interpretation: General augmentation research with a clear, defensible question and convincing experiment/visual explanation; no praise/publication guarantee.

primary.question: Does the clean-task generalization benefit of fixed RandAugment depend on equal-budget early versus late Q/V-LoRA placement in the same pretrained ViT?
primary.precise_delta: Both main arms adapt representations and have the same Q/V rank, number of blocks and total trainable parameters. Shared source images, augmentation RGB trajectory and optimization/selection budgets isolate a practical training-policy interaction.

closest_primary_sources.title: Surgical Fine-Tuning Improves Adaptation to Distribution Shifts
closest_primary_sources.already_covers: Update location versus shift type; augmentation-based MEMO test-time adaptation with freezing.
closest_primary_sources.remaining_difference_in_read_sections: Not the exact same-parameter Q/V-LoRA placement × fixed training-RA clean-generalization interaction.

closest_primary_sources.title: Hint-Aug: Drawing Hints from Foundation Vision Transformers towards Boosted Few-shot Parameter-Efficient Tuning
closest_primary_sources.already_covers: Few-shot PEFT augmentation, LoRA/Adapter/VPT, No-Aug and an RA-plus-color-jitter recipe that can harm fine-grained tasks.
closest_primary_sources.remaining_difference_in_read_sections: Not the fixed total Q/V budget moved from early to late layers. Combination-recipe harm is not RA-only evidence.

closest_primary_sources.title: DynamicAug: Enhancing Transfer Learning Through Dynamic Data Augmentation Strategies Based on Model State
closest_primary_sources.already_covers: Adaptive RA/Mixup/Drop for LoRA, Adapter and Prompt-deep; model-state-dependent intensity.
closest_primary_sources.remaining_difference_in_read_sections: Our main comparison holds RA fixed and varies equal-budget placement; no new scheduling method proposed.

closest_primary_sources.title: Adapting Multimodal Foundation Models for Few-Shot Learning: A Comprehensive Study on Contrastive Captioners
closest_primary_sources.already_covers: Strong-augmentation response differs for linear probing versus LoRA in the reported CoCa setting.
closest_primary_sources.remaining_difference_in_read_sections: Main arms here both use representation adaptation; not a rediscovery of probe-vs-LoRA divergence.
closest_primary_sources.claims_not_adopted: Gradient activity or t-SNE compactness proves generalization or causal mechanism.

backup.question: On exactly identical post-CutMix RA images, does geometrically transported source-area weighting change training outcomes relative to stale weights and canonical RA-before-CutMix?

closest_primary_source.title: OA-CutMix: Correcting the Label Bias of CutMix
closest_primary_source.already_covers: Object-mask-based label correction and spatially aligned mask transformations; label correction while RGB mixing is unchanged.
closest_primary_source.remaining_difference_in_read_sections: Input-provenance geometry, stale/transported targets on identical post-mix RGB, plus canonical order and permuted-target controls.

backup.meaningful_result_requires: Improve over stale target and remain practically competitive with canonical order; same-input target change alone does not establish semantic truth or a useful general method.
